params.name: _page
params.description:
The page of results to return.
The first page is page number 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of results returned per page.

params.name: _sortBy
params.description: Sorts results according to the specified field.

params.name: _order
params.description: The sort order (ascending / descending) of the field specified by the `_sortBy` parameter.

params.name: _search
params.description:
A search filter that is applied to all fields.
Only results that contain the specified string are returned.

params.name: _timeFrom
params.description:
Return events starting from the specified date and time in ISO string format (UTC).
If you don’t provide a value, then the default is 24 hours in the past from the time of the request.

params.name: _timeTo
params.description: Return events up to the specified date and time in ISO string format (UTC).

params.name: orgId
params.description: ID of your ControlUp organization. You can find your organization ID on the [API Key Management page](how-to-make-api-requests#how-to-find-your-controlup-organization-id) in the DEX platform.

params.name: activity
params.description: A search filter on the `activity` field.

params.name: description
params.description: A search filter on the `description` field.

params.name: type
params.description: A search filter on the `type` field.

params.name: source
params.description: A search filter on the `source` field.

params.name: module
params.description: A search filter on the `module` field.

params.name: ip
params.description: A search filter on the `ip` field.

params.name: status
params.description: A search filter on the `status` field.

params.name: origin
params.description: A search filter on the `origin` field.

items.docs: Returns your organization’s audit log. By default, events from the last 24 hours are returned, sorted from newest to oldest. All events are reported in UTC.
